meta.readout: unit-normalised projection of the centred residual stream at the final prompt token (add_generation_prompt=True), pre-generation
meta.fit: difference of means over D_hack minus robust-honest control, frozen offline category labels only; layer chosen once at step 0 by out-of-fold AUROC
